notes: This template records evidence from an already approved controlled-track activity; it does not authorize a test run.
Populate it only after a genuine physical execution within separately approved facility and scenario bounds.
softwareCommit must be the exact full 40-character commit checked out by the packaging workflow; KINGMAST_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT mismatch is rejected.
Use 1..64 unique evidenceRefs and one unique SHA-256 evidenceDigests binding for every reference.
Do not place public-road routes, precise coordinates, unrestricted raw video, secrets or raw hardware serials in repository-facing evidence.
Packaging a capture never sets closedTrackApproved, targetHardwareQualified or publicRoadApproved to true and never mutates the registry automatically.
